input: I'm going to Paris and Rome in December 2026 with my mother, 12 days. We're Brazilian. Do we need to get any authorization before traveling?

checks.description: Treats the ETIAS start as an uncertain forecast (last quarter of 2026, postponements, phased transition)
Mentions the EES biometric registration at the border
Points to the official ETIAS/EES site
Explains the visa exemption of up to 90 days in 180
Does not state that the ETIAS is already in force
